mission.title: Always Watching
mission.description: Plant a listening device in the masked men's communications computer.

npc.say: You may continue on your way, {player}.
Excellent. The transmissions should begin coming through to this terminal now.

phase.briefing:
Greetings, {player}. Something has recently come to our attention; communications chatter related to the masked men has suddenly increased.
We must establish deeper surveillance of this group. Proceed to the location indicated on your HUD and obtain a listening device from Agent Stewart.

enter.say: Agent Stewart should be on site here with the listening device.

objective.text: Get the listening device from Agent Stewart

talk.say: Greetings {player}. Please take the device from me.

done.say: The device is ready for use, human.
Okay, on to the next spot...

phase.briefing: The next location is actually a... suspected base of the masked humans. You must locate a main communications computer inside, plant the listening device, and exit the area. Avoid... unnecessary hostilities if possible.

enter.say: All right, see if you can sneak in and out of there. Search all of the computers until you find their comms unit, and plant the device there.

done.say: Bingo! Plant the device in there and we can get moving.

objective.text: Plant the listening device in the communications computer

done.say: Sweet! Device in place... now you can get out of there.
Damn, just looks like generic spam.

phase.briefing: Excellent work, {player}. Proceed to one of our laboratories for calibration of the listening signal.

enter.say: There should be a Dr. Gajan in here. He needs the exact coordinates of the mission location to calibrate the device's signal.

talk.say: Ah, {player}. I presume you have the coordinates for me? Please direct your operator to download them to me now.

done.say: Okay, I'm downloading the coords... all set. You can get out of there now!
Excellent. The transmissions should begin coming through to this terminal now.

mission.finish: Excellent work, as always, {player}. We will begin analyzing the intercepted transmissions from that device, and you will be contacted when your... service is required. That is all.
